title: Our Son, With the Hottest Take on the Amazon/One Medical $3.9B Deal of Any Six-Year-Old
subtitle: “That would be incredible!”: The power of a compelling brand.
text:
One group has been under represented on Twitter and among the healthcare technorati as we opine on the meaning of Amazon’s acquisition of One Medical. Some have focused on the value of the tech stack. Others have considered Amazon’s entry into the employer-funded healthcare marketplace. Yet others have pondered the role of Iora Health and its Medicare Advantage contracting.

But few of our visionaries understand the power of Amazon’s branding when it comes to rapidly delivering products to six year olds; products that they beg their parents for.

Therefore, I present above a video of my visionary son, who will summarize for us the true potential of this prescient acquisition.
